claim_text: Big Trouser is a gold-farm archetype character whose BUILD is the bank; DLC character
anchor_quote: Big Trouser was added in Patch 0.10.0 (4 August 2022). He is part of the base game, not DLC.

claim_text: Greed scaling (gains +1% Greed every level, no cap) + Candybox access = flexible weapon selection optimized for gold yield
anchor_quote: Gains +1% Greed every level. There is no cap on this bonus. Starting weapon: Candybox.
Added in Patch 0.10.0 (4 August 2022). He is part of the base game, not DLC.

claim_text: Bloody Tear is the evolution of Whip; recipe = Whip + Hollow Heart
anchor_quote: Evolution of the whip. Requires Whip and Hollow Heart.

claim_text: Heal-on-hit (survival mechanic); critical hits; horizontal slash from player
anchor_quote: Restores 8 HP/attack if it hits any enemies with a crit. By default, it is capable of dealing critical hits, which deal 2x damage and have 10% chance to occur.
Added in the December 24, 2021 update (Patch 0.2.4).

claim_text: Death Spiral is the evolution of Axe; recipe = Axe + Candelabrador
anchor_quote: Death Spiral is the evolution of Axe, and requires the Candelabrador.

claim_text: Orbit delivery: nine red spinning scythes around player; arc-throw promoted to whole-ring orbit; ring footprint
anchor_quote: Death Spiral fires nine red spinning scythes around the player in a fixed orbital pattern.
Added to game on October 27, 2021.

claim_text: Fuwalafuwaloo is a union of Vento Sacro + Bloody Tear (both evolutions); most investment-heavy recipe
anchor_quote: Fuwalafuwaloo requires both Vento Sacro at max level and Bloody Tear to create this evolved weapon.

claim_text: Whirlwind slash zone; heal-on-hit from Bloody Tear carries through; melee spin AoE
anchor_quote: The character can heal 8 points of health if an enemy was damaged by a critical hit. Creates multiple dark red slashes horizontally in front of the character and a circle of slashes that cycle around the character.
Added to game in patch 0.7.2 on June 9, 2022. Vento Sacro is part of the base game, not DLC.

claim_text: Gatti Amari (as drafted) — summoned cats wander, eat your pickups, occasionally attack enemies; arsenal chaos archetype; anti-harvest economy
anchor_quote: If a cat walks over a Pickup on the screen, it gets automatically consumed, affecting the cat in different ways.

claim_text: Cats wander in straight lines, change direction; pickup consumption; friendly fire (can damage player 2x)
anchor_quote: The cats can also occasionally hurt the player character when they are close to it, dealing twice the usual damage.
Added April 12, 2022 (Patch 0.5.0).

claim_text: Non-canon because anti-synergistic weapon that consumes player pickups; reverse-harvest economy; proves engine can express deliberately anti-synergistic weapons
Gorgeous Moon is the evolution of Pentagram; recipe = Pentagram + Crown; erase screen AND vacuum every gem simultaneously
anchor_quote: Requires Pentagram (base weapon) + Crown (passive item) to evolve into Gorgeous Moon. Shatters, erasing all enemies on the screen like Pentagram, attracting all the gems on the level, identically to the Vacuum effect.

claim_text: Screen erasure + gem vacuum are simultaneous; harvest-deletion fusion; low tempo (hardcoded 15s cooldown min)
anchor_quote: A hardcoded limit of 15 seconds restricts cooldown reduction effectiveness, preventing Gorgeous Moon from activating more frequently than this threshold allows.
Added to game in the March 12, 2022 patch (v0.3.1).

claim_text: Heaven Sword is the evolution of Cross; recipe = Cross + Clover; boomerang return-path archetype
anchor_quote: Requires Cross + Clover to evolve into Heaven Sword. Throws a giant sword projectile at the closest enemy, which then starts spinning and boomerangs in the opposite direction.

claim_text: Return-path = lane geometry; linear pierce out and back; NOT a true beam; footprint=lane due to double linear traversal
anchor_quote: A giant sword projectile at the closest enemy, which then starts spinning and boomerangs in the opposite direction. The weapon pierces enemies and has Area of Effect damage.
Added December 24, 2021 (Patch 0.2.4).

claim_text: Hellfire is the evolution of Fire Wand; recipe = Fire Wand + Spinach; screen-length flame lance stream
anchor_quote: Evolved Fire Wand. Passes through enemies. Hellfire shoots large flaming meteors at nearby enemies that move slowly in a given direction and Pierce infinitely.

claim_text: Lane footprint (piercing projectile traverses full-screen linear path); delivery=projectile (not sustained beam); burn rider on fire element
anchor_quote: Hellfire shoots large flaming meteors at nearby enemies that move slowly in a given direction and Pierce infinitely. Passes through walls.
Added to game in the 27 October 2021 update.

claim_text: Holy Wand is the evolution of Magic Wand; recipe = Magic Wand + Empty Tome; aim-automation identity
anchor_quote: Requires Magic Wand and Empty Tome. Holy Wand fires non-piercing blue magic bolts at nearby enemies.

claim_text: Fires at nearest enemy with no cooldown after evolution; zero-cooldown post-evo differentiates from base Magic Wand
anchor_quote: Fires with no delay at nearby enemies with automatic targeting to the closest foe. Cooldown: 0.5 seconds.
Added to the game on October 27, 2021.

claim_text: Infinite Corridor = Clock Lancet evo (+ Silver Ring + Gold Ring); Crimson Shroud = Laurel evo (+ Metaglio Left + Metaglio Right); death-kill tech combo
anchor_quote: To obtain Infinite Corridor, players must evolve Clock Lancet while holding both Silver Ring and Gold Ring at maximum level. Crimson Shroud evolution: Laurel + Metaglio Left + Metaglio Right at max level.

claim_text: TRUE BEAM: Clock Lancet fires sustained directional freeze beams across screen; HP-halving effect + Crimson Shroud damage cap = can kill Reaper
anchor_quote: Fires a white beam around the player in twelve directions clockwise one at a time. Creates a spinning, shining rainbow aura around the player, halving the health of every enemy on screen. Caps incoming damage at 10.
Infinite Corridor was introduced in patch 0.6.1 on May 23, 2022. Crimson Shroud added to the game in Patch 0.6.1 (May 23, 2022).

claim_text: Je-Ne-Viv is a DLC character (Tides of Foscari); starting weapons: Insatiable (aura) + Shadow Servant; harvest-stats-as-damage innovation
anchor_quote: Je-Ne-Viv is a DLC character from Tides of the Foscari. Je-Ne-Viv begins with Shadow Servant and Insatiable built-in aura, occupies no weapon slot.

claim_text: Insatiable scales with Magnet (range) and Greed (damage); both normally utility stats converted to attack scaling
anchor_quote: The range of this effect is based on the size of Insatiable, which is affected by Magnet. Insatiable's damage scales with Greed.
Introduced April 13, 2023 via the Tides of the Foscari DLC expansion.

claim_text: La Borra is the evolution of Santa Water; recipe = Santa Water + Attractorb; mobile puddle trail
anchor_quote: Base weapon: Santa Water + Passive item: Attractorb. Rains down bottles of holy water from the sky, which break upon impact, leaving puddles that slowly creep towards the character.

claim_text: Mobile zone-paint: evolved Santa Water converts zone-paint into mobile puddle trail; growing zone radius; area denial over time
anchor_quote: These puddles then slowly creep towards the character, increase in size as they travel, and have a maximum size limit.
Added in Patch 0.2.11 (February 5, 2022).
